# QuestionWale

QuestionWale is a bilingual learning and MCQ-practice platform for Indian competitive-exam preparation. It offers topic-wise revision notes, source-verified practice questions, and structured study guides for UPSC, SSC, Railway, and State exams in English and Hindi.

## Main pages

- [QuestionWale Home](https://questionwale.com/)
- [Browse Subjects](https://questionwale.com/subjects)
- [About Us](https://questionwale.com/about_us)
- [Contact](https://questionwale.com/contact)

- [Company Rule Acts 1773–1853 — Revision Notes](https://questionwale.com/subjects/indian-polity/constitutional-history-making/company-rule-acts-1773-1853/revision)
